What Joby Aviation says to expect

  • Full year 2026: total revenueThe company increased its full year 2026 total revenue outlook to a range of $135 million to $140 million.
  • Second half 2026: use of cashFor the second half of 2026, Joby anticipates use of cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments to be between $385 million and $415 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
